nodes.label: Google's chosen canonical is the slashless URL while the page declares the trailing-slash one
nodes.norm_label: google canonical strips trailing slash while page declares it
nodes.description: The two P0 findings of this slice (docs/features/snippets/ and docs/tools/omnisearch/) are GSC verdicts NEUTRAL with coverageState "Duplicate without user-selected canonical" whose googleCanonical is the slashless URL.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L4338] "Google's chosen canonical contradicts the page's own, so the self-canonical is not being honoured. I did not assert the slashless variant is reachable; that would need a network check, which is forbidden." The same line names the producer: canonical_url() in apps/satteri-docs/src/layout.rs:31-38 always appends the trailing slash, so the page emits .../snippets/ while GSC recorded .../snippets.

nodes.label: An untranslated ID title: frontmatter makes an EN /id/ hreflang twin ship a byte-identical title
nodes.norm_label: untranslated id frontmatter title collides with en twin
nodes.description: Four EN //id/ pairs (tools/audio/, tools/magic-menu/, tools/omnisearch/, tools/pomodoro/) share one title string. The pair is correctly declared as reciprocal twins; only the title is wrong.
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L04340] So this is not a broken localization layer; the pair is correctly declared, and the damage is narrow — an Indonesian searcher sees an English title byte-identical to the EN result, which reads as a duplicate. It's P2, and inconsistent with the other 33 ID pages, which translate even feature names ("Vault & Otentikator MFA", "Statistik & Prestasi").

nodes.label: docs_topic_title() has zero match arms, so BreadcrumbList position 3 is the humanized slug, not the H1
nodes.norm_label: docs topic title humanizes slug instead of curated title
nodes.description: apps/satteri-docs/src/layout.rs:163-165 returns slug.replace('-', " ") unconditionally, against a doc comment promising a curated title when none is registered.
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L02899] Yes — zero match arms, unconditional. The doc comment is wrong. So every 3rd breadcrumb level is a slug humanization, e.g. "mfa authenticator" for a page whose title is "Vault & MFA Authenticator" and whose ID twin breadcrumb says the same. That's a real P3.

nodes.label: layout.rs appends a 15-character brand suffix to every docs title, padding the short ones
nodes.norm_label: unconditional brand suffix pads short docs titles
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L3013] "Title text should carry the page subject; on this chunk the frontmatter titles are 5-26 characters and the appended 15-character brand suffix occupies 36-75% of the rendered string (worst: \"Notes — Snipset Docs\", 5+15 of 20 characters)." The finding was later reworded per chunk after L3274 caught that the 'suffix is larger than the subject' claim is false for C20.

nodes.label: DocsContent has no image-dimension field and the crate emits no width/height, so markdown images reach the browser with no intrinsic size
nodes.norm_label: docs content has no image dimension field
nodes.description: Named as the code-level cause of the 23 imgWithoutDims P2 findings across the six chunks; reported once per chunk with the producer rather than per URL.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L2673] "Confirmed: there is no image post-processing in the docs worker. DocsContent (content.rs:44-53) has no image-dimension field, and layout.rs/docs_layout.rs contain no emitter with width/height." The choice to report it once per chunk is stated at L4342: "a code-level CLS cause, not a score".

nodes.label: A validator run against your own output fails on the validator's scope before it fails on the data
nodes.norm_label: validator failures on self generated data are scope bugs first
nodes.description: The independent validation pass reported 65 failures, then 19, then 6. Every one was a defect in the validator, not in the emitted chunk files; the count reached zero after three rewrites.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset-seo/2026-09-28 - t6-chunks-c15-c20 [ses_f16e31f29ffeTsltrEQUTeBe9I].md:L3745] "All 65 are validator artifacts, not data defects: a sort-order bug in my expected key list, and the verbatim check being applied to repository-source findings (which quote code, not row values)." L3842 gives the second class: a quoted literal in a repository-source finding is legitimate if it is either code in the cited sourcePath or a value the cited code produced.

nodes.label: Fastfetch disk rows labelled Disk {index} with no mount point, UUID, serial, device path or volume label
nodes.norm_label: fastfetch disk rows use generic index labels
nodes.description: The automatic disk module was used with a generic per-row key so every mounted volume shows its filesystem, used/total and percentage, and nothing that identifies the machine.
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - setup-fastpech-untuk-showoff-arch-linux [ses_f2fecbcd2ffedFGmI23FSb061w].md:L8866] "Audit menunjukkan volume yang relevan adalah 3 partisi ter-mount (/, /boot, /home) plus swap. Saya akan gunakan modul disk otomatis dengan Disk {index}, sehingga mount point, nama/label volume, UUID, serial, dan device path tidak ikut tampil. Judul juga saya buat statis agar username/hostname tidak bocor." The stated driver is the user's own instruction at the seq 394 prompt: "pastiin yg dimasukin yg aman dipost ke medsos". The localip and publicip modules were dropped for the same reason (L3046).

nodes.label: CPU, GPU, RAM, kernel, WM and package count are kept in the showoff output even though they are a hardware fingerprint
nodes.norm_label: hardware specs kept for showoff are a fingerprint
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - setup-fastpech-untuk-showoff-arch-linux [ses_f2fecbcd2ffedFGmI23FSb061w].md:L09594] Yang masih terlihat sengaja adalah CPU, GPU, RAM, kernel, WM, dan jumlah paket—informasi ini umum dipakai untuk showoff, tetapi secara teknis bisa menjadi sidik jari hardware.

nodes.label: Fastfetch's Shell module reports the parent process, so it shows the agent harness instead of the shell
nodes.norm_label: fastfetch shell module reports the parent process
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - setup-fastpech-untuk-showoff-arch-linux [ses_f2fecbcd2ffedFGmI23FSb061w].md:L05429] Saya menemukan satu hal khusus untuk Agents: Fastfetch mendeteksi parent process sebagai `opencode`, sehingga modul Shell terlihat `opencode` ketika dijalankan dari harness; dari terminal interaktif biasa seharusnya mendeteksi shell yang sedang dipakai.
